Visioner BREAKING | 🇺🇸 🇦🇪 ‼️ ‼️ A US Air Force F-35A stealth fighter has reportedly declared an in-flight emergency over the United Arab Emirates before disappearing from public flight-tracking platforms. According to flight-tracking reports, the aircraft switched its transponder to emergency code 7700, which indicates a general aviation emergency. This is reportedly the second such incident involving a US F-35A in the past seven days. The fighter was last tracked over Emirati airspace before its signal disappeared. There is currently no confirmation of a crash, hostile engagement, or the aircraft’s operational status. The incident comes amid heightened US military activity and tensions involving Iran. However, losing a public tracking signal does not necessarily indicate an aircraft has crashed, particularly in the case of military aviation. The nature of the emergency remains unknown, and further information from US military authorities will be needed to establish what happened. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet

Visioner BIG | 🇵🇱 🇷🇺 🇺🇦 ‼️ ‼️ NATO will provide Poland with an AWACS early-warning aircraft following reports that three Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles landed on Polish territory during Moscow’s massive attack against Ukraine on November 20. Poland’s Deputy Defence Minister announced the decision after a North Atlantic Council meeting in Brussels. According to the Polish account, the missile incidents prompted additional measures to strengthen the country’s airspace surveillance. The minister explained that NATO’s AWACS aircraft would provide greater operational awareness, allowing Polish forces to detect potential threats earlier and respond more effectively. The deployment would strengthen NATO’s ability to monitor aerial threats along its eastern flank. AWACS aircraft can detect and track targets over large distances, giving air defense units more time to react. The reported missile incidents also highlight the risk that Russia’s continued strikes against Ukraine pose to neighboring NATO countries, increasing pressure on the alliance to reinforce its defensive capabilities. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet

💥 US air cover fails as three tankers hit mines in Hormuz Three tankers violating designated routes in the Strait of Hormuz hit naval mines and erupted in massive fires, the IRGC Navy said. One tanker was struck near the southern coast and two others in the eastern part of the strait while under extensive US military air escort. The IRGC Navy said the American cover failed to prevent the incidents . 💬 “The Strait of Hormuz is not a place to test unauthorized routes or ignore maritime warnings,” the IRGC Navy warned. Shipowners and operators were warned that US military protection does not replace compliance with Iranian maritime instructions. 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime

“I am absolutely fed up with Russia’s lies about its alleged desire for peace,” EU Ambassador to Ukraine Katarina Mathernova said, responding to Russian strikes in the Kyiv region that killed 15 people. According to the diplomat, while Moscow claims to be ready for peace talks, Russian forces continue to kill Ukrainian civilians. “I am truly tired and can no longer tolerate Russia’s lies. This is what Russia’s ‘desire for peace’ looks like: 15 dead and at least 25 wounded civilians, including small children,” Mathernova stated. She also shared that she had recently been near the site of a Russian drone explosion in Kyiv. Asked by CNN about the prospects for peace negotiations with Russia, the Ambassador admitted: “It is becoming increasingly difficult for me to answer such questions using diplomatic language.”
